notes.title: Quick development update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Here's a quick update on the development progress of the game so far and what's up next.



I'm currently working on making the game fully playable, which means adding lots of content, gameplay mechanics and visuals to it. It's going well and the content is about 50% finished. Here's a sneak peek at one of the areas from the middle of the game:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469078/1b75296d08ca19b0d78e435ef84694c2d4713e8b.png"]

There's also a free demo planned to be released in August 2025. This one is already fully playable, but needs some more fine-tuning and polishing touches to really shine, which I'm also working on :)



It's been a bit quiet around here since the announcement of the game a few months back, but I'll make sure to share some progress updates and infos about the game more regularly from now on. Stay tuned!



Thanks a lot for your interest and support!

Erkberg
